name: REVEREND SOWERBY
note: SOWERBY AT THE GATE (doc 57 C3 and D4: on the funeral day, if Sheng's task is set, 'Sowerby is at the gate with the plate'). His funeral sheet, cut from room-31's master and lit by the same moon on the same hill (tools/art/room31-night.py); no sheet of him holds the plate, so the plate is in the direction, not the picture -- for Tyler's playthrough. He is there for the visit that ends the day, and back in his church after.
barksNote: The exchange at the gate is an arrival scene (Room 14 onEnter.scenes), not a bark.
